rows.text: The release dated 20 May 2009 states that Dr. Manmohan Singh, chosen as leader of the Congress Parliamentary Party, called on the President at 5.00 p.m. with Smt. Sonia Gandhi and letters of support, and that the President, satisfied that the Congress-led UPA could command majority support in the 15th Lok Sabha, appointed him as the Prime Minister and asked him to indicate the members of the new Council of Ministers.

locator.section: Release body, first and second paragraphs

rows.text: The same release states that the President will administer the oaths of office and secrecy on Friday, 22 May 2009, at a time to be decided.
